# PhysxPhysicsJointInstancer

Instances joints from prototype joints. The runtime's joint-instancer loader parses each prototype joint once, then creates one joint per protoIndices entry, composing the per-instance local frames with the prototype's and binding the per-instance bodies.

- **Type chain:** `PhysxPhysicsInstancer`, [`Imageable`](glossary.md#imageable), [`Typed`](glossary.md#typed)
- **Applicable APIs:** [`CollectionAPI`](CollectionAPI.md), [`GeomInstanceAPI`](GeomInstanceAPI.md), [`GeomInstanceRootAPI`](GeomInstanceRootAPI.md), [`GeomPrototypeAPI`](GeomPrototypeAPI.md), [`PhysicsMaterialAPI`](PhysicsMaterialAPI.md), [`PhysxAutoDeformableAttachmentAPI`](PhysxAutoDeformableAttachmentAPI.md), [`PhysxMaterialAPI`](PhysxMaterialAPI.md), [`PhysxSceneAPI`](PhysxSceneAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleAutoGearBoxAPI`](PhysxVehicleAutoGearBoxAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleClutchAPI`](PhysxVehicleClutchAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI`](PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI`](PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleEngineAPI`](PhysxVehicleEngineAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleGearsAPI`](PhysxVehicleGearsAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleNonlinearCommandResponseAPI`](PhysxVehicleNonlinearCommandResponseAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleSuspensionAPI`](PhysxVehicleSuspensionAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleTireAPI`](PhysxVehicleTireAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleWheelAPI`](PhysxVehicleWheelAPI.md), [`PrototypeRootAPI`](PrototypeRootAPI.md)
- **Transform columns:** none, not [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable)
- **Uses blocks:** [`prim`](prim.md)

## What USD population writes

Schema attributes and authored relationships are published like any physics prim's (see the [prim block](prim.md#columns)).

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the [USD](glossary.md#usd) schema value. *Producer writes* is what [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `physics:prototypes` | uint64 array, RELATIONSHIP_PATH_ID |  |  | not written |  | No prototype joints: nothing is created. |
| `physics:protoIndices` | int32 array | none |  | not written |  | Warns that the indices array is not valid and creates no joint. |
| `physics:body0s` | uint64 array, RELATIONSHIP_PATH_ID |  |  | not written |  | body0 is the world for every instance. |
| `physics:body1s` | uint64 array, RELATIONSHIP_PATH_ID |  |  | not written |  | body1 is the world for every instance. |
| `physics:body0Indices` | int32 array | none |  | not written |  | Warns; every instance uses index -1, so a body0 target is taken as a body, never as a [PointInstancer](glossary.md#pointinstancer) instance. |
| `physics:body1Indices` | int32 array | none |  | not written |  | Warns; every instance uses index -1, so a body1 target is taken as a body, never as a PointInstancer instance. |
| `physics:localPos0s` | float32[3] array, POINT | length |  | not written |  | Warns; the instance frame on body0 is at the origin (the prototype's localPos0 still applies). |
| `physics:localRot0s` | float16[4] array, QUATERNION | none |  | not written |  | Identity instance rotation on body0. |
| `physics:localPos1s` | float32[3] array, POINT | length |  | not written |  | Warns; the instance frame on body1 is at the origin (the prototype's localPos1 still applies). |
| `physics:localRot1s` | float16[4] array, QUATERNION | none |  | not written |  | Identity instance rotation on body1. |

## Interactions

- **[`PointInstancer`](PointInstancer.md):** A body target that is a PointInstancer selects one of its instances by the matching body index (see that component's protoIndices and prototypes).
- **[`PhysicsJoint`](PhysicsJoint.md):** Each prototype is an ordinary joint prim parsed once; the instance frames multiply its localPos/localRot.
